Standard toric exact sequences are proof tools rather than identical results. Search results do not establish universal novelty, and uninspected originating full text remains a real priority risk.

value.rationale: Wu's K-polystable toric construction parametrizes the complete rational alpha interval, making torus-fixed local singularity invariants an intrinsically motivated classification target. The result determines both non-Q-factorial free defects and precise torsion at all fixed-point charts, with arithmetic jumps at integer hyperplane-slice parameters; it goes beyond general class-group algorithms and the known single Liu--Zhu parameter specialization.
